title: fix(ui): a wizard form view keeps layout horizontal, and the form page draws it as steps
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ858UZPVazGF5N8yCfayxT1g)_
Fixes #27224

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:分步表单(`type: 'wizard'`)写 `layout: 'horizontal'` 时每一步的字段标签都放到输入框左侧;`/forms/:name` 与 `/f/:slug` 表单页把分步表单画成逐步填写(步骤条、下一步/上一步、最后一步提交)。
- 为什么改:这两项都能保存发布,但分步表单把 layout 固定成 vertical,表单页把所有分节堆在一页,作者以为生效了其实没有。
- 风险与回滚:只改 WizardForm 的一处 layout 传值和表单页的 wizard 分支;simple、tabbed 与不写 layout 的表单行为不变(有对照测试);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`(`renderWizardSteps`、`handleWizardNext`、提交被拒时跳到出错步骤)、`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx`(`layout: schema.layout ?? 'vertical'`)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.wizardSteps-27224.test.tsx`,预期 11 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

1. **A wizard form keeps `layout: 'horizontal'`.** `ObjectForm` hands the authored key to `WizardForm` in its `{...schema}` spread, and the step form node `WizardForm` built said `layout: 'vertical'` whatever the form view said. It now passes `schema.layout ?? 'vertical'`, the shape `TabbedForm` got in PR #27222, and declares `layout` on `WizardFormSchema` as `ObjectFormSchema['layout']`. Every field on every step draws its label beside the control from `sm` up, through the form renderer's existing horizontal arrangement. The auto-stepper path (`mobile.stepper`) spreads the same schema, so it keeps the key too.
2. **The form page draws `type: 'wizard'` as steps.** `/forms/:name` and the public `/f/:slug` read `type` only for `tabbed`, so a wizard view drew every section stacked on one page. A wizard view with more than one section now draws, with the semantics of the app's wizard form and the spec's FormView wizard contract (D4 step gate, D5 derived progress):
   - a step indicator, one step per section in array order, labelled by the section heading (else the `wizard.stepFallback` text), hidden by `showStepIndicator: false`;
   - **Next** checks the current step's fields with the same rules the final submit applies (`findSubmitRefusals` over that one section) and opens the next step only when none is refused; a refused step is marked in the indicator and the refusal message is the page's existing one;
   - **Back** is always free; a later step opens from the indicator once completed, or at once under `allowSkip` (`canOpenWizardStep`, the rule `WizardForm`'s `canOpenStep` applies);
   - **Submit** appears on the last step only and carries every step's fields (the page's one `values` map); a submit refused for a missing field, or a faulted `visibleWhen`, opens the step holding the first field it names and marks every step a refused field sits on;
   - Enter in a field before the last step is that step's Next; a `continue` submit behaviour starts the wizard over from step one;
   - every step stays mounted and only the current one is drawn (the `hidden` attribute), so a control on another step keeps its widget state, an upload in flight included;
   - a step with no fields shows the `wizard.emptyStep` text, as the app's wizard does;
   - a wizard view with a single section draws it stacked, as a single-section tabbed view does.

   The refusal reporting that `handleSubmit` inlined is lifted into `reportRefusals` so Next and the final submit put the same messages on the same channel. Every string the wizard draws is an existing catalogue key (`wizard.progressLabel`, `wizard.stepFallback`, `wizard.back`, `wizard.emptyStep`, `common.next`, `form.stepOf`), so no locale pack changes.

`FORM_SPEC_TYPES` is left as it is; its split/drawer/modal entries belong to #27159.

## Why

Both keys are authorable and saved, and both drew as if absent: a wizard form view's `layout: 'horizontal'` and the form page's `type: 'wizard'`. This is the wizard arm of the defect PR #27222 closed for simple and tabbed forms (triage 6468472559: the filer's Expected stands).

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/wizardFormLayout-27224.test.tsx` (3): horizontal on step one and, after Next, on step two; CONTROLS: no `layout`, and `vertical`, draw vertical.
- `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.wizardSteps-27224.test.tsx` (11): steps drawn, only the current one shown, Next and no Back or Submit on step one; Next and Back, completed steps reopen from the indicator and an uncompleted one does not; Next refuses an outstanding required field and writes nothing; Enter is Next; the submit carries every step's fields; `allowSkip` opens any step and a refused submit opens the step holding the field; `showStepIndicator: false`; horizontal rows on every step; `canOpenWizardStep` unit cases. CONTROLS: a single-section wizard draws stacked with Submit and no indicator; a `simple` view draws every section stacked with Submit and no steps.

Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head `15589ba4`, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:

- `WizardForm.tsx` back to `layout: 'vertical'`: the horizontal test reds (1 failed, 2 passed: both controls stay green).
- `FormPage.tsx` with `wizardView` forced to `false`: all 8 wizard tests red, the 3 controls (single section, simple view, `canOpenWizardStep`) stay green.

## Acceptance notes

- The page's step gate checks what the page can check: `required`, `requiredWhen`, `readonlyWhen` and a faulted `visibleWhen`, through the rules its final submit already applies. Like the app's wizard, it is a UI admission rule, never authorization; the server re-validates the record on submit.
- `nextText` / `prevText` are not FormView keys (they live on the `object-form` component props), so the page draws the catalogue's Next and Back.
